description: Per-serving nutritional values for a recipe. Core fields are always present; additional fields are populated when the nutrition data source/API provides them.

sugar.description: Total sugars; note added vs natural when available

glycemic_index.description: Estimated glycemic index; important for diabetic users

optional_fields.description: Captured when the nutrition data API provides them

mesh_axis.description: Optional derived 1-10 healthiness axis for the filter mesh. The front-end may instead let users filter on any raw field directly (e.g. a calories slider, or a glycemic_index cap for diabetics).
mesh_axis.orientation: higher = less healthy (1 = most nutrient-dense, 10 = least)
mesh_axis.derivation: Composite of calories_per_serving, sugar, fiber, and glycemic_index relative to per-serving norms
